overview.summary: ExampleVault accepts USDC deposits, mints share tokens, and lends assets through an external money market. Withdrawals convert shares back to assets at the current exchange rate. The owner, a governance timelock, can pause the vault and rescue stray tokens.

functions.name: deposit

access.detail: Any account may call this function.

functions.whatItDoes: Pulls USDC from the caller, credits the receiver with newly minted vault shares, and forwards the assets to the money market. It reverts when the deposit would exceed the vault cap.

access.detail: Any account may call this function; the caller must hold an allowance when withdrawing on behalf of another owner.

functions.name: pause

access.detail: Only the contract owner may call this function.

functions.whatItDoes: Stops deposits, mints, withdrawals, and redemptions until the owner unpauses the vault.

functions.name: rescueTokens

access.detail: Only the contract owner may call this function.

functions.whatItDoes: Sends a stray ERC20 token balance held by the vault to the owner. It refuses to move the vault's own share token or the underlying asset.

checks.title: Proxy implementation is verified
checks.detail: Blockscout reports full source verification for ExampleVaultV2 at the EIP-1967 implementation slot.

checks.title: Owner is a governance timelock
checks.detail: onlyOwner functions are gated behind GovernanceTimelock, observed calling setFeeRecipient 3 times and pause once.

checks.title: One selector in bytecode is unresolved
checks.detail: Selector 0xdeadbeef appears in the runtime bytecode but matches no ABI entry and no signature database entry.

checks.title: rescueTokens targets a caller-supplied token
checks.detail: The token address rescued is an argument, not a fixed address. Confirm the owner is trusted before relying on this function.

checks.title: Runtime counts are a sample, not a lifetime total
checks.detail: 900 of 3120 candidate transactions were traced in a 50000-block window (about 6.9 days).

checks.title: No explicit reentrancy guard found on deposit/withdraw
checks.detail: Static analysis found no nonReentrant modifier on deposit, mint, withdraw, or redeem. External calls occur after state writes in deposit but before state writes in withdraw.
